title: Quaint Juicy Chinese Pork Dumplings
description: A traditional Hakka dish featuring pork and kaffir lime leaf, wrapped in corn husks and steamed to perfection, this recipe brings back nostalgic memories of Chinese cuisine.

ingredients.name: ground pork
ingredients.notes: preferably with some fat content for juiciness

instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine ground pork, grated ginger, minced garlic, soffritto base, kaffir lime leaves, sesame oil, soy sauce, salt, and black pepper, and mix well until just combined.
Lay a corn husk flat on a work surface, with the wide end facing you, and place about 1 tablespoon of the pork mixture in the center of the husk.
Fold the sides of the husk over the filling, and then roll the dumpling up, starting from the wide end, to form a tight cylinder.
Repeat with the remaining corn husks and pork mixture.
Place the dumplings in a steamer lined with parchment paper, leaving some space between each dumpling.
Steam the dumplings over boiling water for 15 minutes, or until cooked through.
Serve the dumplings hot, with your choice of dipping sauce.
Garnish with additional kaffir lime leaves and grated ginger, if desired.
